scripts.check: bun run env:check && bun run env:contract && bun run lint && bun run server:typecheck && bun run test && bun run server:build
scripts.cli:build: bun run http-client:build && bun run --cwd packages/cli build
scripts.dev: bunx varlock run -- sh -c 'bun --cwd apps/server --watch src/index.ts & server_pid=$!; bun run --cwd apps/website dev --strictPort --port 3100 & website_pid=$!; trap "kill $server_pid $website_pid 2>/dev/null" INT TERM EXIT; while kill -0 $server_pid 2>/dev/null && kill -0 $website_pid 2>/dev/null; do sleep 1; done; kill $server_pid $website_pid 2>/dev/null; wait $server_pid $website_pid 2>/dev/null'
scripts.server:db:generate: bunx varlock run -- bun run --cwd apps/server db:generate
scripts.server:db:migrate: bunx varlock run -- bun run --cwd apps/server db:migrate
scripts.server:dev: bunx varlock run -- bun run --cwd apps/server dev
scripts.server:start: bunx varlock run -- bun run --cwd apps/server start
scripts.server:test: VARLOCK_ENV=test bunx varlock run -- bun run --cwd apps/server test
scripts.test: bun run server:test && bun run cli:test
scripts.website:build: bunx varlock run -- bun run --cwd apps/website build
scripts.website:dev: bunx varlock run -- bun run --cwd apps/website dev
